name: Liam
source:
Liam is tired of living with his horrible body. Almost every second of the day is torture to him. In addition to that, another purple axolotl is picking on him.

[spoiler]ALLEN's sickly side and manifestation of his chronic physical pain. Because of the pain Allen suffered, he had to eat a lot of medicine which he hated. The result was Enc's hatred towards Liam.

He reincarnated as The Lowly Healer in Kingdom of Glass where RB inserted him and Enc to solve their relationship.[/spoiler]
